description: FoodShare is Wisconsin’s SNAP grocery assistance program. Apply through ACCESS or the county or Tribal agency and complete the required interview.
introduction: FoodShare is Wisconsin’s SNAP grocery assistance program. Apply through ACCESS or the county or Tribal agency and complete the required interview.

who: Households meeting FoodShare financial and program requirements.
Some members must meet work requirements; the agency screens exemptions and sends applicable notices.
sections.get: Food purchasing assistance for approved households. Apply for an agency determination even if unsure which household or work rule applies.
sections.docs: Prepare household identity, income and relevant expense information. After the interview, follow the agency’s exact verification request and ask about missing records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through ACCESS, call or visit the local agency, or submit paper form F-16019.
  2. Call the agency for the interview or answer its call; interviews are by phone unless you request an in-person meeting.
  3. Explain relevant work-rule exemptions and send requested proof.
sections.after: Use MyACCESS to manage benefits and follow notices about reporting and renewal. If subject to the time-limited work requirement without exemption, the state lists three months in the current January 2025–December 2027 period. Ask the agency about exemptions, good cause and FSET support.

faqs: Yes, the current application page requires one.
Can I request an in-person interview?
It is based on your county or Tribal affiliation.
How do I report a possible work exemption?
Contact the agency or use ACCESS as directed by the work requirement page.
FoodShare Employment and Training is a free employment and training support program.
